global_experience.layout: Content sits in a centred column up to about 1200px wide with comfortable side margins. The header and the hero background may span the full width.
global_experience.look: Style, tone, color and fonts come from the brief's brand and look. Text is real text laid over images, never part of an image.
global_experience.header: The site name on the left, anchor links in the middle or right, and one accent button (the main button) on the right. Sticky, with a 1px bottom border once the page scrolls. On phones the links collapse behind a menu button.
global_experience.feedback: There are no forms. The main button goes where the owner's link points, or scrolls to the closing section when no link is set. FAQ items open and close with the keyboard.
global_experience.empty_states: A section the owner switched off is not on the page and not in the navigation. A missing image shows a plain labelled placeholder box, never a broken image.

pages.purpose: Make the product clear in five seconds and send the visitor through the main button.
pages.sections: The sections from the brief in order. Default order: hero (headline, subheadline, main button, product image placeholder), benefits bento, how it works, pricing, testimonials, FAQ, closing call to action, footer. Optional sections the owner turned on (examples gallery, comparison table, use-case cards) sit after how it works.

states.loading: The page is rendered at build time, so there is no loading state.
states.main_button: Opens the owner's link. With no link it scrolls to the closing section.
states.pricing_toggle: With monthly and yearly billing, a Monthly / Yearly switch changes every price shown in the section and nothing else. Monthly is the default view.

pages.purpose: Tell the visitor the page does not exist and offer a way home.
pages.sections: A short message and a link to the home page.
